verdict.rationale: The Marketing API is exposed under a versioned path (GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/), which shows the API is versioned. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how breaking changes are handled, so only half the story is evidenced and thinly. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning documentation for the Transactional API, changelog or breaking-change notices, independent corroboration.
